additional_requirements.title: Test auditing of changes in deployment configuration
additional_requirements.text: For each deployment configuration, ensure changes made to it are audited and tracked.

additional_requirements.title: Test presence of scanners to identify and prevent sensitive data in deployment configuration
additional_requirements.text: For each deployment configuration file, verify that scanners are set to identify and prevent the existence of sensitive data within it.

additional_requirements.title: Test limitation of access to deployment configurations
additional_requirements.text: Verify each deployment configuration is accessible only to known and authorized users.

additional_requirements.title: Test verification of deployment configuration manifests
additional_requirements.text: For each deployment configuration manifest in use, ensure it has been verified.

additional_requirements.title: Test pinning of deployment configuration manifests to a specific, verified version
additional_requirements.text: For every deployment configuration manifest in use, ensure it is pinned to a specific version or commit Secure Hash Algorithm (SHA).

additional_requirements.title: Test separation of deployment configuration files from source code
additional_requirements.text: Ensure each deployment configuration file is stored separately from source code.

additional_requirements.title: Test scanning of Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
additional_requirements.text: For every Infrastructure as Code (IaC) instructions file, verify that scanners are set to identify and prevent misconfigurations and insecure instructions.
